sections.title: Putting it together
sections.content: Describe an area with *hay*, then ask where a particular place is with ¿*Dónde*...? and answer with estar.

sections.title: A simple exchange
rows: En mi barrio hay una farmacia.
There is a pharmacy in my neighbourhood.
It is next to the bank.

items.spanish: Hay un museo en el centro.
items.english: There is a museum in the centre.

sections.content: A useful sequence is: say what exists, ask where it is, then give its location.
